description: Focused improvement flow for one implemented section/component cluster without forcing a page or whole-product redesign lifecycle.

stages.purpose: Inspect project truth, current UI owner and the smallest root cause before changing code.

gates.require: affected owner, constraints and expected outcome are known
material user/problem claims distinguish direct evidence from proxy/inference and define a truthful validation plan when direct evidence is unavailable

stages.purpose: Apply the smallest reusable implementation change while preserving project design language and unrelated work.

gates.require: changed behavior has a pass condition and focused verification
critical outcome metrics have event/data-source definitions, privacy/consent considerations, owners and verification before release

stages.purpose: Verify the actual rendered change and prevent regression across affected shared owners.

gates.require: changed UI is inspected in representative states/viewports
verified versus unverified areas are explicit; completion claims do not exceed evidence
an authorized human decision owner reviews unresolved risk, outcome readiness and rollback/learning plan before production release when project policy requires it
post-launch signals, critical experience checks, review cadence and rollback criteria are explicit for the affected surface

policies.reason: Rendered QA failed; return to implementation with root-cause review.
The assumed UI owner/root cause was wrong; re-inspect current project truth.
Risk escalated beyond a local polish task; add production reality/testing specialists.
Diagnose repeated tool failure rather than blind retry.
Blocked local improvement needs decision reframing before more edits.
